title: Product Designer: small demonstration roadmap, not a full career curriculum

nodes.title: Understand the user problem
nodes.outcome: Create an evidence-based problem statement for one small product concept.

nodes.title: User research fundamentals and interview planning
nodes.outcome: Write a research question, recruitment criteria and a five-question interview guide.

nodes.title: Practice an interview and synthesize observations
nodes.outcome: Conduct a practice interview with consent and summarize observations without identifying participants.

nodes.title: Build a concise research case study
nodes.outcome: Present a problem statement, research observations and three justified design requirements.

nodes.title: Design and communicate a solution
nodes.outcome: Produce and review a small interactive prototype linked to the research findings.

nodes.title: Information hierarchy, layout and accessible interaction
nodes.outcome: Sketch a clear task flow and identify keyboard, contrast and labeling requirements.

nodes.title: Create a prototype for one user task
nodes.outcome: Build a prototype covering a successful path, an empty state and an error state.

nodes.title: Review the prototype and explain design decisions
nodes.outcome: Demonstrate the task flow and explain two design decisions using the research evidence.
